per_panel_scene_hints.01: No host. No woman. No face. Sleek charcoal cat staring at a calendar-without-a-day: ghost week grid, no weekday circled. Magenta tape pins a blank. Huge white hook: Monday: "this week". Wednesday. No day. Phone face-down optional — never a 23:41 clock hero. Metaphor: sensing the promise already dissolving. In-scene cat, no die-cut halo.
per_panel_scene_hints.02: No host. Type-heavy. Loyal dog beside empty weekday chips — hollow Thursday and Friday evening slots, no extra slogans. Metaphor: loyalty to the unanswered promise. Headline: Thursday and Friday nights are frozen.
per_panel_scene_hints.03: No host. Type-heavy. Dog waiting at a closed calendar / unopened planner door. Metaphor: waiting at a closed calendar door. Headline: The mistake: waiting for a last-minute ping.
per_panel_scene_hints.04: No host. Cat watching a floating reservation card hover over a dateless calendar — a hold with no day, no time, no place. Magenta tape as visual hold. Metaphor: sensing a hold that only benefits him. Headline: "This week" books you with zero cost.
per_panel_scene_hints.05: No host. Owl, night-clarity, perched above a decoder stack (says → you hear → reality). Metaphor: night clarity: words versus meaning. Headline: What he says vs what it means.
per_panel_scene_hints.06: No host. Owl perched above a 1-2-3 checklist. Visual contrast: one filled slot chip vs empty chips. Metaphor: sober checklist instead of hope. Headline: 3 signs of a real invitation.
per_panel_scene_hints.07: No host. Cat turning away from the floating reservation card, closing a week calendar. Metaphor: reclaiming calendar autonomy. Headline: No day by evening — week is yours.
per_panel_scene_hints.08: No host. Owl as quiet witness beside a real booked slot vs a question-mark hold. Metaphor: short rule worth rereading. Headline: He books your time, not your anxiety.
per_panel_scene_hints.09: No host. No woman. No face. No animal required. Coffee cup, phone face-down (not a lit 23:41 clock), magenta tape, floating reservation card. Huge thin magenta handwritten SLOT. White sans: Comment. Body verbatim: Audio reading in my app. Essence–Shadow–Vector. Product app_audio. No bot. No Academy. Links in the profile.
